symbolic.name: schwarzschild_ricci_flat
symbolic.description: Static spherically symmetric vacuum metric is Ricci-flat (Einstein's vacuum equations)
symbolic.formula: ds^2 = -exp(2phi) dt^2 + exp(-2phi) dr^2 + r^2 dOmega^2, phi = ln(1-2m/r)/2

symbolic.name: photon_sphere
symbolic.description: Photon sphere and critical impact parameter for a Schwarzschild BH
symbolic.formula: b_c^2 = r^2/(1 - 2m/r) minimised at r = 3m -> b_c = 3 sqrt(3) m

checks.label: b^2 has a minimum at r = 3m

symbolic.name: isco_schwarzschild
symbolic.description: Innermost stable circular orbit radius from the effective potential

symbolic.name: kerr_horizons_ergosphere
symbolic.formula: r +/- = m +/- sqrt(m^2 - a^2); r_ergo(theta) = m + sqrt(m^2 - a^2 cos^2 theta)

checks.label: ergosphere r_ergo(theta) = m + sqrt(m^2 - a^2 cos^2 theta)

symbolic.name: morris_thorne_exotic_density
symbolic.description: Morris-Thorne wormhole exotic density and flare-out condition
symbolic.formula: rho(r) = b'(r)/(8 pi G r^2); with b(r) = b0^2/r -> rho = -b0^2/(8 pi G r^4) < 0

symbolic.name: eddington_luminosity
symbolic.description: Eddington luminosity from radiation-pressure/gravity balance on hydrogen
symbolic.formula: L sigma_T/(4 pi r^2 c) = G M m_p/r^2  ->  L_Edd = 4 pi G M m_p c/sigma_T

checks.label: L_Edd = 4 pi G M m_p c / sigma_T

symbolic.name: hawking_temperature
symbolic.description: Hawking temperature from surface gravity kappa = c^4/(4GM)
symbolic.formula: T_H = hbar kappa/(2 pi k_B c), kappa = c^4/(4GM)

checks.label: T_H = hbar c^3/(8 pi G M k_B)
entropy from kappa -> area law S = k_B A/(4 l_P^2)

symbolic.name: friedmann_continuity
symbolic.description: Friedmann + acceleration equations imply the continuity equation

symbolic.name: light_deflection
symbolic.description: First-order light deflection by a Schwarzschild BH

symbolic.name: gw_time_to_coalescence
symbolic.description: Time-to-coalescence for a circular binary, leading order in 1/c

symbolic.name: kerr_isco_spin
symbolic.description: Bardeen-Press-Teukolsky ISCO formula and its spin limits
symbolic.formula: r_ISCO/M = 3 + Z2 - sqrt((3-Z1)(3+Z1+2 Z2)) for prograde a in [0,1]

symbolic.name: penrose_efficiency
symbolic.formula: eta = 1 - E_out/M with E_out = M / sqrt(2)

symbolic.name: shadow_diameter
symbolic.description: BH shadow diameter in Schwarzschild spacetime
symbolic.formula: D_sh = 2 b_c = 2 sqrt(27) G M / c^2 ≈ 10.39 GM/c^2

checks.label: D_shadow = 2 b_c = 6 sqrt(3) m = 2 sqrt(27) GM/c^2
